sale_verified: This sale was verified against the Pi ledger.
payment_not_on_chain: The payment was not found on-chain yet. It may still be confirming.
receipt_unconfirmed: This is held until the buyer confirms receipt, or the dispute window closes.
dispute_window_open: The dispute window is still open. The reward becomes final after it closes with no dispute.
reward_pending_approval: This reward is prepared and waits for the weekly approval.
reward_final: This reward is final and payable.
listing_admitted: This listing is admitted under the rulebook.
listing_not_admitted: This listing is not admitted under the rulebook.
cap_exceeded: A daily cap was reached, so this could not be recorded today.
appeal_submitted: Your appeal was submitted and is waiting for review.
appeal_upheld: Your appeal was upheld and the decision changed.
appeal_denied: Your appeal was reviewed and the original decision stands.
appeal_under_review: An appeal on this item is being reviewed.
question_answered: This question was answered with a citation to the rulebook.
